Nonprofits

Tax, campaign finance and election-law guidance for nonprofit political and issue advocacy.

Our approach

← All practice areas

TPLG advises 501(c)(3) charities and foundations, 501(c)(4) social welfare organizations, 501(c)(6) trade associations, 527 organizations and affiliated political committees on the tax, campaign finance and election laws governing political and issue advocacy.

We counsel organizations on formation and structure, political campaign activity, lobbying, issue advocacy, ballot measure activity, affiliated PACs and other political organizations, funding and disclosure. For organizations operating across jurisdictions or through multiple affiliated entities, we help clients understand how different regulatory regimes interact and structure programs accordingly.

Our lawyers serve as outside counsel to nonprofit organizations and advocacy programs nationwide, helping clients pursue their missions while navigating the legal boundaries applicable to tax-exempt organizations and political activity.

Political law counsel nationwide.
